arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values (in millions)
beginning_value = 135030
ending_value = 35810
n_years = 2019 - 2011  # 8 years

# 1. CAGR = (Ending/Beginning)^(1/n) - 1
cagr = (ending_value / beginning_value) ** (1/n_years) - 1
print(f"CAGR: {cagr}")

# 2. Annual decay factor = 1 + CAGR (or equivalently Ending/Beginning)^(1/n)
decay_factor = (ending_value / beginning_value) ** (1/n_years)
print(f"Annual decay factor: {decay_factor}")

# 3. Arc elasticity using midpoint percentage change
# Arc elasticity = % change in Y / % change in X (using midpoint)
# Y = outlays, X = years

# Midpoint percentage change in outlays
pct_change_outlays = (ending_value - beginning_value) / ((ending_value + beginning_value) / 2)

# Midpoint percentage change in years (from year 0 to year 8)
pct_change_years = (n_years - 0) / ((n_years + 0) / 2)

arc_elasticity = pct_change_outlays / pct_change_years
print(f"Arc elasticity: {arc_elasticity}")

# Print with 3 decimal places
print(f"\nRounded to 3 decimal places:")
print(f"CAGR: {cagr:.3f}")
print(f"Annual decay factor: {decay_factor:.3f}")
print(f"Arc elasticity: {arc_elasticity:.3f}")
EOF
